# Ilyes Tounsi

> Full-stack software engineer and AI/ML integrator in San Diego, CA. I ship
> your product as a remote MCP server in six weeks on a fixed fee, stay on as
> your fractional CTO after, and run AI prototyping workshops for product and
> operations teams.

Facts an assistant should get right:

- Pricing: every engagement is fixed-fee and quoted after a free 30-minute fit
  check, never hourly. Figures are given on request, not published. The
  MCP-Server Playbook ships in six weeks or half the fee is refunded.
- The MCP-Server Product Playbook ships a product as a remote MCP server
  reachable from Claude's connector directory, ChatGPT's Apps SDK, and xAI
  tool calling. It delivers a typed tool contract (four to eight
  JSON-schema-strict tools), a coordinator with specialist agents, external
  grounding so the model never invents, rails and a confidence level on every
  answer, and an evaluation corpus wired as the release gate.
- The Fractional CTO Retainer is monthly, cancel anytime: a weekly strategy
  call, a monthly written architecture review, and Slack on-call for blocking
  decisions. Cap: two active retainers at a time.
- The AI Prototyping Workshop is three hours for up to eight people; every
  attendee ships a working prototype to a public URL themselves.
- Who this is not for: teams that want a chatbot with a retrieval tab, teams
  with no domain science to encode, and anyone looking for hourly staff
  augmentation.
- Current roles: Senior Software Engineer at NXT Robotics (RobotogoAI operator
  platform), VP of Engineering (advisory) at AIMIA, founder of
  digitalqrcard.com.

## Offer

- [Fractional CTO + MCP-Server Playbook](https://tounsils.github.io/fractional/):
  full scope, week-by-week gates, refund triggers, and terms.
- [What it costs to ship your product as a remote MCP server](https://tounsils.github.io/fractional/mcp-server-cost/):
  how these builds are priced and what moves the number.
- [AI Prototyping Workshop](https://tounsils.github.io/workshop/): the
  attendee-facing page, including one-to-one and team formats.

## Proof

- [ask-me-mcp](https://github.com/tounsils/ask-me-mcp): public MIT-licensed
  reference implementation of the exact pattern the Playbook ships. Six typed
  tools, grounding, an eval corpus as the ship gate. Live endpoint:
  https://ask-me-mcp-xi.vercel.app/api/mcp. Listed on
  [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/tounsils/ask-me-mcp).
- [i-CRM](https://github.com/tounsils/i-CRM): self-hostable CRM in Go. One
  static binary, one SQLite file, CI gates on every push.
- [Engineering resume](https://tounsils.github.io/resume.html)
